## security-reviewer:data-exposure:b4905e27

```yaml

```

**Reviewer:** security-reviewer

```
Marker strings are not neutralized in reflected values. Nothing requires checking rendered values for the literal <!-- and --> sequences, yet the whole authorship boundary depends on those literals appearing only at the real boundaries. A trailer or rationale containing the literal closing marker produces a second closing-marker-shaped string, letting cicd delivery or the interlock test misidentify the true boundary. Require HTML-comment delimiter neutralization in the same escaping pass, plus an acceptance criterion asserting exactly one literal occurrence of each marker string.
```

**Reviewer:** security-reviewer

```
Escaping contract omits the markdown table delimiter and covers only trailers. The enumerated set is ] , newline and backtick; it omits | (the table cell delimiter) and leading #/-/> block syntax. The attention map rationale is specified "reproduced verbatim" and every section renders as a table. Extend the single escaping routine to every value interpolated into a table cell, including rationale, and replace "reproduced verbatim" with "reproduced verbatim content, escaped for table-cell safety". CWE-116.
```

```
Path traversal via the Spec: trailer value. The trailer path is used for filesystem lookups with no containment or canonicalization rule; trailer values are attacker-influenceable. Resolve every Spec:-derived path with path.resolve, require it to start with the canonicalized .context-index/specs/ root before any fs.stat/fs.readFile, and treat an escaping path identically to "does not exist on disk". CWE-22. Add an acceptance criterion and a test with a ../ trailer value.
```

The UNKNOWN invariant is unimplementable as written. "When a task appears in the changed files but has no corresponding routing entry" presupposes a task-to-file mapping no declared input provides: routing.json entries carry task_id, selected_agent, scores, rationale only — no files[]. The spec never says whether the task universe comes from Plan-task: trailers, the plan Task Summary, or elsewhere. Declare the authoritative enumeration of tasks in range and the derivation of each task file set, so UNKNOWN has a defined domain.
